summary: Wipro Limited furnished a Form 6-K reporting the outcome of a Board meeting held October 14-15, 2026, at which directors approved audited standalone and consolidated financial results under Ind AS and IFRS for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The filing attaches the October 15 letter to the NSE, BSE and NYSE and the auditor's report; it discloses no stake, price, premium or transaction terms. The event is a routine periodic earnings release, equivalent to a US quarterly results announcement, with no special-situations mechanics or risk-arb angle to monitor.
